name: Font Viewer
description: Fonts in Orca's editor tabs: .ttf, .otf, .woff, .woff2, .ttc and .otc. Type your own sample at any size, move variable axes, switch OpenType features, browse every character by Unicode block with code points to copy, and read names, metrics, licence and tables. Works offline; never edits the file.

cover.alt: Font Viewer on a variable font: your own text as a large sample at 72 px in a heavy, casual style, under the size controls.

screenshots.alt: Variable axes at work: weight 800, Casual 1 and slant -15 on the sample text; the named instance reads Custom.
Code ligatures switched on in a monospaced font: the dlig feature checked and != => >= drawn as single glyphs.
A CJK font with 47,336 glyphs by Unicode block: 20,992 CJK Unified Ideographs, one selected with its code point to copy.
A .ttc font collection with face 33 of 36 picked in Face: its name, style and 2,937 glyphs, previewed on the sample.
The Info tab: vertical metrics and variable axes, then the OFL licence and its embedding rights. Shown in Orca's light theme.
